name: Box Content API v2 Presets (read-only ingestion)
setup_hint: Store a Box developer token (or app access token) via secret-guard as BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN / BOX_DEVELOPER_TOKEN. OAuth authorize/refresh profiles can be layered on later following canva.json once an app registration exists.

get_folder_items.description: List items in a Box folder. Marker-based pagination: pass usemarker=true and the marker cursor from the previous response's next_marker so incremental sync (DA-03) can resume where it left off.

folder_id.description: Folder ID; 0 is the root folder.

marker.description: Pagination cursor: the next_marker value returned by the previous page.

usemarker.description: Enable marker-based pagination (required for marker to take effect).

sort.description: Sort field: id, name, or date.

get_file_info.description: Get metadata for a Box file (etag/sha1/modified_at support change detection).

download_file.description: Download Box file content (the API answers with a redirect to the download URL; the HTTP client follows it).

version.description: Optional file version ID to download.

ancestor_folder_ids.description: Comma-separated folder IDs to scope the search.

updated_at_range.description: ISO-8601 from,to range for incremental discovery.
